title: CLOSE TO THEE
author: Fanny J. Crosby
stanzas: Thou my everlasting portion, more than friend or life to me, all along my pilgrim journey, Savior, let me walk with thee.
Not for ease or worldly pleasure, nor for fame my prayer shall be; gladly will I toil and suffer, only let me walk with thee.
Lead me thru the vale of shadows, bear me o'er life's fitful sea; then the gate of life eternal may I enter, Lord, with thee.
chorus: Close to thee, close to thee, close to thee, close to thee, all along my pilgrim journey, Savior, let me walk with thee.
